cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Quality Assurance Trainee, Civil Construction role at Mendi Constructions, advertised on SEEK. The first duty in your advert, assisting with site inspections and quality checks, is work I did on two projects in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020.

On the first, a community hall renovation, I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, and escalated issues that needed clarification or corrective action. I also reviewed the structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. On the second, residential subdivision finishing works, I assisted with site inspections and quality checks and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage and applied Australian Standards in the drawings. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Townsville for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I have my own reliable transport. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: The option that names a graduate temporary work visa (Subclass 485). If the list has no such option, choose the temporary visa option that has no restriction on hours or industry.

questions.question: How many years' experience do you have as a Quality Assurance Trainee?
questions.answer: Choose the lowest option (no paid role in that role). This row never covers an engineering title: a graduate, junior, site, project or civil engineer title is answered from the first row.
